import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Create Voronoi tessellation using PostGIS
# First, get the bounding box of all stations, then create Voronoi and clip
query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
    FROM air_quality_station
),
station_multipoint AS (
    SELECT ST_Collect(coordinate) as geom FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(coordinate)) as geom FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(st.geom))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM station_multipoint st
),
voronoi_with_id AS (
    SELECT 
        v.cell_geom,
        s.id,
        s.name_en
    FROM voronoi v
    CROSS JOIN stations s
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.cell_geom, s.coordinate)
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT 
        v.id,
        v.name_en,
        ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.geom) as clipped_cell
    FROM voronoi_with_id v
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
)
SELECT 
    id,
    name_en,
    ST_Area(clipped_cell::geography) / 1000000.0 as area_km2
FROM clipped
ORDER BY area_km2
""")
result_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result_df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Create Voronoi tessellation using PostGIS - cast geography to geometry
query = text("""
WITH stations AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geometry as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
station_multipoint AS (
    SELECT ST_Collect(geom) as geom FROM stations
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(geom)) as geom FROM stations
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(st.geom))).geom as cell_geom,
           (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(st.geom))).path[1] as cell_idx
    FROM station_multipoint st
),
voronoi_with_id AS (
    SELECT 
        v.cell_geom,
        s.id,
        s.name_en
    FROM voronoi v
    CROSS JOIN stations s
    WHERE ST_Intersects(v.cell_geom, s.geom)
    AND ST_DWithin(v.cell_geom, s.geom, 0.001)
),
clipped AS (
    SELECT 
        v.id,
        v.name_en,
        ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.geom) as clipped_cell
    FROM voronoi_with_id v
    CROSS JOIN bbox b
)
SELECT 
    id,
    name_en,
    ST_Area(clipped_cell::geography) / 1000000.0 as area_km2
FROM clipped
ORDER BY area_km2
""")
result_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result_df)
